evidence: Landing page renders a Nothing-inspired industrial portfolio aesthetic with monochrome surfaces and restrained red accents.
The landing page includes navigation, hero, about, experience, projects, skills, and contact sections.
Portfolio copy and metadata come from the centralized config/portfolio.php data layer and are injected through the controller.
Responsive CSS keeps the page usable on desktop and mobile with stacked layouts below the tablet breakpoint.
Motion is restrained and reduced-motion preferences disable transitions and scroll animation.
